description: Use for a short euro exchange rate history: daily ECB reference rates of one currency against EUR for up to the last 30 days, with min, max, mean and percent change. Returns the paid x402 request for your input (GET /eu/fx/history, $0.002 per call; schema linked). Call that URL with an x402 or MPP client to get the data. Bad input is refused before any charge. One currency, up to 30 days; for the latest rates of all currencies use eu_fx. With an access key (Authorization: Bearer p0k_..., buy at https://x402-bazaar-rank.x402-bazaar-rank-worker.workers.dev/keys/buy?usd=5) the tool pays the call itself, returns the data and deducts the price. First call each day returns the data itself, free; later calls return the paid request.

ccy.description: ISO 4217 code of the currency quoted against EUR, e.g. USD, GBP, JPY; must be one the ECB publishes

days.description: calendar days back from the latest ECB publication, default 30 (out-of-range values are clamped); fewer rows than days because the ECB publishes on TARGET working days only

name: eu_fx_history
title: Eu fx history
